text: Entry Requirements (1) Applicants: Non-Chinese citizens holding valid foreign ordinary passports; the duration of language learning within China shall not exceed 2 years. (2) Age requirement: 18-40 years old (scholarship applicants must meet the age requirements of each program). (3) Physical Condition: In good health, meeting the health examination standards for applying for a student visa or residence permit in China. (4) Moral Cultivation: China-friendly, upright in behavior, law-abiding, and respectful of Chinese customs and habits. (5) Financial Status: Able to cover the costs of tuition, accommodation, and daily living expenses. Note: The university does not provide on-campus housing. Admitted students are required to arrange their own accommodation in Guangzhou.
